'''Nar Hekka''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located barely beyond the edge of the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]], where it also [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Unidentified star (Nar Hekka)|dim red star]].<ref name="THG" /> It was situated on the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the worlds of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Du Hutta]].<ref name="TEA" /> Nar Hekka also sat on the [[Sheela Run]].<ref name="TGoNH" />

==Description==
Nar Hekka was a [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA" /> with little indigenous [[Plant/Legends|plant]] and animal life. Despite the hostile environment, [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] rectified this by erecting large hothouse [[Domed city/Legends|domes]] around their [[City/Legends|cities]] and planting foreign vegetation within. The domes had artificial wind generators to circulate the air around the many botanical gardens.
==History==
Centuries before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], an eccentric boss of a [[Hutt Clan]] was responsible for transforming the planet by installing domed gardens, arboretums and parks, which eventually filled the planet.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Nar Hekka was the home and business headquarters of [[Tagta]] the Hutt, a subordinate to [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron|Jiliac]].

It was assumedly conquered by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warmaster]] [[Nas Choka]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]'s subjugation of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], though the amount of botanical plant life on the planet may have granted it some concessions. It was [[Terraforming/Legends|vongformed]] by the Yuuzhan Vong.

As a result, Vong vegetation came to be added to the existing plant life.<ref name="TEA" />
